data.title: Rehabilitation and Widening of 64 km District Roads Package-IV (Including Three Bridges)
data.issuer: Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Communication & Works Department
data.summary: Sealed bids are invited for rehabilitation, widening and improvement of 64 km of district roads under Package-IV. The scope includes reconstruction of three reinforced concrete bridges (spans 40m, 65m and 110m), roadside drainage, retaining structures and road safety furniture, with a 24-month construction period including two monsoon seasons.

criteria.description: Evaluation of bidder’s relevant experience in roads and structures.

criteria.name: Construction methodology and work program
criteria.description: Assessment of the proposed construction methodology and work program.

criteria.name: Key personnel and equipment
criteria.description: Assessment of proposed key personnel and available equipment.

criteria.name: QA/QC, HSE and environmental compliance
criteria.description: Assessment of QA/QC approach, HSE management, and environmental compliance.

qa_items.question: Submit a detailed construction methodology covering earthworks, pavement layers, structures and traffic management.
Provide a CPM-based work program demonstrating completion within 24 months including monsoon conditions.
Provide proposed key staff details including Project Manager (PEC registered professional engineer, 15+ years) and Bridge Engineer (10+ years).
Describe the HSE management system and provide a documented zero-fatality record over the last five years (preferred).
Propose a quality control plan with on-site laboratory facilities for soils, aggregates, concrete and asphalt testing.

data.submission_instructions: Bids shall be submitted to the Office of the Superintending Engineer, C&W; Circle, Peshawar, in sealed envelopes under the single stage one envelope procedure as per KPPRA Rules 2014.
